notes.title: v 0.1.4 - The Mapping Update!
notes.notes:
It's been quite a while since the last update, and this is one that finally adds maps to the game, a feature common in other games like this one! It's a mostly minor update for anything not related to maps.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/6ab5bce87a3b6dec5710952e67dc15a9989890ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/886b109a5bb2d6d6876d33b94b635ff362b285e2.png
Revealing maps!

A greater sense of mystery has been added to the boundaries of your exploration after the spaceship is repaired!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/ebed8a430b0af0e8b55cc7b38b2e44c9137c000a.png
Note: Existing saves will automatically have the map unlocked regardless if the spaceship is repaired. Since the game didn't save which chunks have been explored before the update, existing saves will initially have empty maps, even in already explored regions. For new saves, it'll be locked and inaccessible until the player has repaired the spaceship, where a map icon flashes green at the bottom right corner of the screen to grab your attention, intended to let players know about the unlocked map!

New tool animations!

Although this update focuses mainly on maps, this update has also tweaked the tool swinging animation for pickaxes, swords, and axes!

This is another biome-based update, but with a focus on the now previously lacking desert cave biome! It's a sort of antithesis update with the taiga caves, focusing on a hot biome instead of a cold one!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/6732fc32f55b3c4c20a9c43a3553a6951875f783.png

notes.title: v 0.1.2.1 - Critical spaceship bug fix
notes.notes:
Critical bug fix!

 Fixed critical bug where spaceship data is deleted from the save file for new and existing saves after saving the game.

A compromise on affected saves

If you've tried out the update in v 0.1.2, and saved the game, all spaceship data has been deleted, and when loading the game again, the spaceship is gone, stranding players on the same world.

If the game is still on v 0.1.2, refrain from playing any saves until the game updates to v 0.1.2.1.

For affected saves, the game will add a spaceship at the player's position. If the player is in a cave at the time of saving, it'll add the spaceship at that same position, but at the surface. It'll be a maxed out spaceship with no fuel inside, and will appear on the compass.

notes.title: v 0.1.2 - The Taiga cave update!
notes.notes:
Hello Cosmorists!

This is an update similar to the Verdant update, but focuses on the taiga cave biome instead, which previously lacked content compared to other similar cave biomes! You might want to visit the taiga biome on Tierra, and visit their caves to experience the new content!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/6ab5bce87a3b6dec5710952e67dc15a9989890ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/886b109a5bb2d6d6876d33b94b635ff362b285e2.png
Overhauled Taiga caves

In the taiga cave biome, a lot more new and exclusive content awaits, as well as a fresh look to it!

The taiga cave biome will also have variations between parts of the biome that are above freezing, and other parts that are below freezing. Here's an example of a part that's above freezing!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/b28dcada64470b9804586eee91fe660238bc83b8.png

Now for an area of the biome that's below freezing!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/2b0f388bf4490651bd9100052742dfd2226547c0.png

If you're brave enough to go to some of the colder taiga biomes on Tierra, and go deep enough in their caves at around 15 layers deep that's still below freezing, you might stumble across wonders like this!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/8ea0aff753e0d549c7deb9b4cd8b6c33501a343e.png

A new toolset

With this biome overhaul also comes a new set of tools!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/92605d3f71de6d3fcc0edfd2492d20ac75f00527.png
Using any of these tools also lowers the player's body temperature by a certain amount per use when one durability is taken! A lot more dangerous to use in cold biomes such as the taiga caves that they originate from, but very useful if you find yourself in blisteringly hot biomes such as the hottest of deserts, lava caves, or magma forests! They're still not as effective in hot underwater environments such as the equatorial region of Aquatica.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/6ab5bce87a3b6dec5710952e67dc15a9989890ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/d5472fb2ce1a458640b8d39ef56276c6865bd070.png

A data structure change

If you've read the Latest in Cosmorists for January 2025, you might have noticed that I worked on changing how the game saves data. This is the update that changes it!

Existing saves will still work, as backwards compatibility has also been taken into consideration, but once an existing save file is saved, it'll be converted to the new data structure.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/24937ae3c065e113cf757aec8dbe24b87acbf009.png
In the screenshot above, the save at the bottom is before the conversion, and the one on top is after. The file size is expected to be around 2x larger, but will still be within the 10s or 100s of kilobytes range for the majority of saves.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/6ab5bce87a3b6dec5710952e67dc15a9989890ea.png

notes.title: v 0.1.1 - The Verdant Update!
notes.notes:
Hello Cosmorists!

A new cave biome was added, and is the main focus of this update! You might want to go to Tierra if you're on another world, visit the Temperate forest biome, and go to their caves to see the new biome! It'll generate on existing saves as well!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/6ab5bce87a3b6dec5710952e67dc15a9989890ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/886b109a5bb2d6d6876d33b94b635ff362b285e2.png
The Verdant Cave biome


Below the Temperate forests, a new biome is waiting to be explored!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/86ec72af9d66f81946ff18bb6bab82a3fb0a4fef.png

Temperate forests, being the only surface biome with no cave biome of its own on Tierra prior to this update, now has one, the Verdant Cave biome! Plant life here runs rampant, and so do some enemies, but look at the potential scenery of this new plant-filled biome!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/a3d61fdfb6a0464b1a22c20d348769cdab1604e4.png

Glowing plants are abundant in the shallower parts of this biome, but become increasingly rare at deeper depths until layer 50, where at this point, glowing plants are nearly non-existent!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/bf9131ac64639f0827f37980e7f4eb5f4bb4e4dc.png

At layers 50 and below, the enemies start to get more dangerous! Not only are there a bunch of bats, there's a variant that when killed, spawns even more smaller bats. There's also an enemy that can immobilize any cosmorist for 2 seconds via a new debuff, but be on the lookout for a new gadget found in treasure chests that can only be found in this biome at these depths! It requires no electricity to function!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/b5965ba4cd4618848a1031492f5380dcb55bbd65.png

New Music!

With this new update also comes new music that plays in this biome! If you were in the discord server, you might have came across an audio file of the music slowed and pitched down! It's slowed and pitched down by a factor of around 2.5 from the actual music, and this is what plays in the Verdant caves!



A note about this update

Existing saves will also experience the new biome, as well as new ones, but bases in existing saves made in areas where the Verdant Caves will generate will immediately experience the new biome, but with a world generation change.

If your base is located in any dirt cave biome below temperate forests, taiga biomes, or glacier biomes close to taigas, or some stone caves also below those same biomes, that base will likely have cave walls overriding everything except for any tile placed or mined by the player.

notes.title: Narrow Echoes update now live!
notes.notes:
Hello Cosmorists!

The first major update of 2025 is here, kicking off the perfect square year with the Narrow Echoes update! Let's get to what's been added!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/6ab5bce87a3b6dec5710952e67dc15a9989890ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/886b109a5bb2d6d6876d33b94b635ff362b285e2.png

Swaying trees

Is the world feeling a bit static? It will now feel less so with the trees now reacting to the wind, which will occasionally drop their leaves, and those leaves will also blow in the wind! Check out those new tree animations :D

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/ad33ca0c19e4b5649e6ab62482ce04ab58028b19.gif


Much smaller worlds!

Exploring the world, only to encounter the same biome for millions of tiles? That will now change with worlds being much smaller for newer saves!

Exploring the world will now result in the same biome for a few thousand tiles instead of millions, which will allow exploring biomes once separated by thousands of kilometers much more manageable on foot!

There's also a new slider for small, medium, and large world sizes!

Explosives

Tired of mining one tile at a time with your pickaxe? This update offers a way to quickly destroy multiple tiles simultaneously!

Explosives!

So far, they're only found in treasure chests and barrels in caves, and are great for quickly mining large nodes of ore, but be careful, as they deal lots of damage if you're particularly close to the epicenter of any explosion they produce!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/7682366386d4487719ce9517e79c22310745cfc1.gif

Research Stalkers

The night on Tierra is about to offer a greater challenge to your scientific ambitions! Research Stalkers are creatures that don't care about any cosmorist wandering by. Their passive behavior will change dramatically as soon as it notices that your inventory contains science, where it will stalk you with a passion, trying to rob you of your scientific progress!

Once it steals your science, it will run away with your stolen science in an attempt to despawn, and once it despawns, so would the stolen science!

Here's how those research stalkers will behave once it tries to steal your science!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/45e02401646d5f3cf00935e8160d031e60bf18e9.gif

Quick Stack

A neat quality of life feature that wasn't initially announced is present in this update!
This feature allows players to move many of the same types of items to and from chests with the click of a single button!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/59bce12e777ef33245d0efe3c597a450319cb561.gif

Other notable changes

Steam cloud

This is a feature that wasn't mentioned prior to the launch of the update, but the game now supports cloud saves! If you look at the saves menu, there will now be a cloud icon next to each of them indicating if they're on the Steam cloud. Existing saves won't be uploaded to the cloud when the game starts, but new saves will be uploaded by default. That behavior can be turned off in the settings, or for each individual save!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/8ab75d99ffc0a8289cc4462daf0475f1618b7d11.png

Autosave

Another feature relating to saves! The game will now automatically save every 10 minutes with a warning at the top of the screen when the game is about to autosave. This feature was added so that in the event of a game crash or freeze mid-session, less progress would be lost. The save interval can be changed in the settings, or can be turned off!

No music at night on Tierra!

The music that used to play at night will no longer play, as the night in this update is more unsettling than in prior versions as the music would suggest. In its place are the idle sounds coming from the new enemies, and the ambient sounds!
If music is playing while the sun slowly sets, it'll fade out as usual, but after that, silence! The lack of music at night is intended to put more emphasis on the idle sounds of the new enemies! The section is added there in case this is reported as a bug :)

And many more!

I could go on, but this list will get too long, now onto to the notable rebalances!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/6ab5bce87a3b6dec5710952e67dc15a9989890ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/bfe63199e4876b4a3b9a31251a9d1bdff3d0d23a.png

Chemical Science

Prior to this update, Chemical science was easier to obtain than Material science in the early game, but that's going to change!

Chemical Crystals{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/dc7123bb471556d13c9d45b2531be689576b6746.png, the resource used as a part of the crafting recipe for Chemical science, is now harder to obtain in the early game, no longer spawning in the dirt caves. The only way to obtain it prior to discovering the chemical crystal biome is to kill some research stalkers, which has a 10% chance to drop a Chemical Crystal. This is meant to incentivize early game players to engage with the night to obtain the Chemical Crystals necessary to make Chemical Science!

Magtise items now less common

Ore generation

Magtise ores are now twice as uncommon. It also has a chance to not generate if the temperature it's generated at is between 40°C and 100°C, where lower temperatures in this range further increases the ore's rarity.

Treasure

Treasures in the lava caves will no longer contain magtise tools or weapons, with the only magtise item able to be generated now being magtise spears.

Enemies

All enemies in the lava caves except for the Magtise wanderer will no longer drop Magtise ore.
Magtise wanderers also spawn 4x less frequently, drop 2x less Magtise ore, and will no longer spawn if the ambient temperature is less than 50°C.

Intended effect

Removing all of these options to obtain Magtise ore makes mining it, or fighting Magtise wanderers the best way to obtain it. The deeper the player goes, the more common it gets, but also the more common dangerous enemies are, and the hotter it gets.
This is also intended to increase the value of finding Magtise ore, and the excitement for crafting tools and weapons out of it!



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/50787c6245f7590af1f29938425472ce8d9768cf.png

I'll admit, I almost never use Discord myself, and I'm much less familiar with it compared to other platforms, which is mainly why the game didn't initially have a discord server, but due to popular demand, a fairly basic Discord Server for Cosmorists is now available!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/6ab5bce87a3b6dec5710952e67dc15a9989890ea.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/d5bebd1d4dc2e5067e336e998d92d40640b7b74e.png

 Fixed bug where the tooltip and health bars don't scale with different window resolutions.
 Fixed bug where turning on fullscreen with a different resolution clips out a portion of the screen.

notes.title: v 0.0.1 - Minor content update & bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hello Cosmorists!

Thanks for the feedback provided since launch, and pointing out bugs and crashes that I missed prior to launch! This first post-launch update adds a small amount of content, and fixes some bugs that were reported. Let's get to the primary piece of content that has been added so far!

Primary content added

In the chemical crystal biome on Tierra, a new danger lurks!

Chemical Crystal Wanderers!

These enemies look a lot like the other chemical crystals at first glance, but will aggressively ward off unsuspecting players, and will shoot their shards in all directions. Here it is in action!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44545324/27f92a7a3838aa008f87768cd8b40f980ed267c5.gif

Now for the rest of the changes made since the first launch build, as well as the bug fixes!


Full changelog

Enemies

+ Chemical Crystal Wanderer

Graphics

 Ground items now move up and down on the screen

Items

+ Sandstone Axe
+ Sandstone Bow
+ Sandstone Pickaxe
+ Sandstone Sword
 Increased the mass of all sciences 10-fold.

Spaceship

 Doubled the takeoff speed of each spaceship.

Crash fixes

 Fixed crash where saving the game involving campfires or evaporative coolers can sometimes corrupt the save.

Bug fixes

 Fixed rendering bug where certain base tiles flicker horizontal black lines when the player moves.
 Fixed bug where items can't be picked up with a full inventory that can pick it up.
 Fixed bug where landing sites don't save spawn points set by beds.
 Fixed bug where saving the game while the spaceship takes off puts the player and the spaceship in a different part of the world.

Exploit fixes

 Fixed duplication exploit where picking up all items in a single layer, saving the game, and reloading it can cause those same items to reappear.
